summary: Desktop AI workspace where a boss agent coordinates specialist agents in parallel, on your own Claude, Codex or Gemini login, to build apps, designs or videos with a live preview.
description: Desktop AI workspace where a boss agent coordinates specialist agents in parallel, on your own Claude, Codex or Gemini login, to build apps, designs or videos with a live preview.

pricing.details: Free to download, with your own AI login — 1 boss agent, 2 worker agents and 2 projects. Pro is the same full app at 12 €/month, or 118 €/year (official yearly price, about two months offered vs monthly), or 236 € lifetime (one-time, no subscription). Optional hosted models can be added on Free or Pro: 18 €, 46 € or 91 € per month, billed monthly, same 34 models, only the monthly credits differ. Official Black Friday promo: 50% off Granular Pro — a promo, not the normal list price. Amounts are converted from the official list; checkout is via Stripe.
